body.objective: Determine whether strict parity-even pure Weyl gravity generates any parity-odd third-curvature form-factor coefficient at one Euclidean loop, and separate a symmetry-forced zero from a missing regulated trace.
body.stop_condition: Import the independently frozen parity-odd carrier and the exact strict pure-Weyl minimal/nonminimal Hessian and ghost determinant data.  Define parity and orientation reversal on every field, ghost, antifield, zero-mode and determinant block and on the chosen regulator/measure.  Prove the regulated one-loop trace is parity invariant and hence all nonexact odd-carrier coefficients vanish, or compute the first nonzero coefficient with an exact spectral/heat-kernel witness, or certify the first missing orientation-sensitive regulator/measure datum that leaves the coefficient undefined.  Treat the local Pontryagin anomaly representative separately from nonlocal derivative-decorated odd form factors.  Check scheme dependence and finite odd counterterms explicitly, and use a method-distinct spectral or invariant trace verifier.
body.current_gate: zero, nonzero or precisely undefined parity-odd one-loop coefficient vector
body.forbid: no parity-even classical action alone used as proof that the quantum measure is parity invariant; no local Pontryagin class conflated with all odd nonlocal form factors; no coefficient inferred from carrier dimension; no Lorentzian, QME, state, particle or unitarity promotion
activates: a complete even/odd one-loop third-curvature effective-action table
or the exact regulator/measure input required to define the odd coefficient
body.resource_hint: QUANTUM COEFFICIENT GATE.  Prefer an exact parity/measure theorem; if the measure data are incomplete, certify nondefinition rather than guessing zero.
notes: A symmetry-forced zero would close an open half of the one-loop effective-action architecture without selecting a compensator action.
A nondefinition result is useful only if it names the exact missing determinant or regulator datum.
